entries.meaningZh: 不谦逊；自负、炫耀自己的态度
entries.en: The immodesty of his acceptance speech embarrassed even his closest friends.
entries.zh: 他获奖致辞中的自夸让最亲近的朋友都感到尴尬。

entries.meaningZh: 专横、生硬或过分强硬的处理方式
entries.en: The teacher's heavy-handedness turned a small disagreement into a classroom argument.
entries.zh: 老师过于强硬的处理方式，把小分歧变成了课堂争执。

entries.meaningZh: VCD：视频光盘；本例采用常见影音义
entries.en: We found the school concert on an old VCD.
entries.zh: 我们在一张旧视频光盘上找到了那场学校音乐会的录像。

entries.meaningZh: it is的缩写：它是；本例为it is
entries.en: It's too windy to eat outside tonight.
entries.zh: 今晚风太大，不适合在外面吃饭。

entries.meaningZh: 构成名词的词尾-tion；本例见promotion
entries.en: Her promotion brought new responsibilities as well as a higher salary.
entries.zh: 她的晋升不仅带来了更高的薪水，也带来了新的职责。

entries.meaningZh: Aug.：August的缩写，八月
entries.en: The invitation gives the date as 18 Aug.
entries.zh: 请柬将日期写为八月十八日。

entries.meaningZh: Capt.：captain的缩写；本例指船长
entries.en: Capt. Reed asked the crew to secure the loose rope.
entries.zh: 里德船长让船员固定好那根松脱的绳索。

entries.meaningZh: MA：Master of Arts，文学硕士学位；另选学位义
entries.en: She completed an MA in history before joining the museum.
entries.zh: 她进入博物馆工作前取得了历史学文学硕士学位。

entries.meaningZh: HMS：英国皇家海军舰名前缀，His或Her Majesty's Ship
entries.en: The lifebuoy carried the ship's name, HMS Falcon.
entries.zh: 救生圈上印着舰名：英国皇家海军猎鹰号。

entries.meaningZh: biz：business的非正式说法，生意或业务
entries.en: She left the restaurant biz to open a small bookshop.
entries.zh: 她离开餐饮行业，开了一家小书店。

entries.meaningZh: Mg（原词库写作MG）：镁的化学符号
entries.en: The worksheet asked us to match Mg with the name magnesium.
entries.zh: 练习单要求我们将符号Mg与元素名称镁配对。

entries.meaningZh: 协调；协作；英式拼写，等同coordination
entries.en: The rescue depended on close co-ordination between the two teams.
entries.zh: 这次救援依靠两支队伍之间的密切协作。

entries.meaningZh: ST：segment table的缩写，计算机段表；本例采用该专门义
entries.en: The debugger displayed the ST beside the memory map.
entries.zh: 调试器在内存映射旁显示了段表。

entries.meaningZh: Inc.：incorporated的缩写，用于公司名称
entries.en: The receipt was issued by Oak Lane Books Inc.
entries.zh: 这张收据由橡树巷图书公司开具。

entries.meaningZh: G：吉、十亿倍的单位前缀；本例见GHz
entries.en: The processor's speed was listed as 3.2 GHz.
entries.zh: 这款处理器的速度标为3.2吉赫兹。

entries.meaningZh: LE：less than or equal的缩写，小于或等于；本例为比较条件
entries.en: The filter used LE to include values equal to the upper limit.
entries.zh: 筛选器使用小于或等于的条件，将等于上限的数值也包括在内。

entries.meaningZh: Nt：氡的旧符号，历史资料用法
entries.en: On the old element chart, radon was marked Nt.
entries.zh: 在那张旧元素表上，氡被标作Nt。

entries.meaningZh: BR：bus request的缩写，总线请求；本例为计算机信号
entries.en: The controller raised BR to request access to the bus.
entries.zh: 控制器发出了总线请求信号，申请使用总线。

entries.meaningZh: ED：error detection的缩写，错误检测；本例为计算机专门义
entries.en: The receiver's ED routine flagged a damaged packet.
entries.zh: 接收器的检错程序标记了一个损坏的数据包。

entries.meaningZh: von：用于部分德语姓名的成分；原词库首字母大写
entries.en: The guest list included a pianist named Clara von Stein.
entries.zh: 宾客名单上有一位名叫克拉拉·冯·施泰因的钢琴家。

entries.meaningZh: vi：一种文本编辑器；本例为计算机义
entries.en: He opened the configuration file in vi.
entries.zh: 他用vi文本编辑器打开了配置文件。

entries.meaningZh: EM：end of medium，介质结束控制符
entries.en: The parser stopped when it reached the EM control character.
entries.zh: 解析器读到介质结束控制符EM时便停止处理。

entries.meaningZh: UX：user experience，用户体验
entries.en: The UX team watched how visitors used the new menu.
entries.zh: 用户体验团队观察了访客如何使用新菜单。

entries.meaningZh: REG：Windows注册表文件，通常使用.reg扩展名
entries.en: Keep a copy of the REG file before changing its entries.
entries.zh: 修改其中的条目前，先保留一份REG注册表文件副本。

entries.meaningZh: cor：心脏；拉丁医学词，非日常heart的常规替代
entries.en: The old anatomy glossary paired cor with the English word heart.
entries.zh: 那本旧解剖学词汇表将cor与英语单词heart对应起来。

entries.meaningZh: NME：National Military Establishment，美国历史机构名称的缩写
entries.en: An NME official signed the old defence memorandum.
entries.zh: 一位国家军事机构官员签署了那份旧国防备忘录。

entries.meaningZh: AA：automatic answer的缩写，自动应答；本例采用设备标记义
entries.en: The modem's AA light showed that automatic answering was enabled.
entries.zh: 调制解调器的AA指示灯表明自动应答功能已启用。

entries.meaningZh: DTI：Department of Trade and Industry，英国原贸易工业部；历史语境
entries.en: The file contained an old DTI letter about export licences.
entries.zh: 文件中有一封英国原贸易工业部关于出口许可证的旧信。

entries.meaningZh: Insp.：inspector的缩写；本例为警衔、称谓
entries.en: Insp. Carter took notes as the witness described the bicycle.
entries.zh: 卡特督察在证人描述那辆自行车时做了笔记。

entries.meaningZh: ABS：anti-lock braking system，防抱死制动系统；另选常见汽车义
entries.en: The dashboard showed an ABS warning after the car was serviced.
entries.zh: 汽车保养后，仪表盘上亮起了防抱死制动系统警告灯。

entries.meaningZh: RBI：run batted in，棒球中的打点
entries.en: Her double produced the team's only RBI of the game.
entries.zh: 她的那记二垒安打带来了球队本场唯一的打点。

entries.meaningZh: TUC：Trades Union Congress，英国工会联合组织名称
entries.en: The proposal was discussed at a TUC meeting.
entries.zh: 这项提议在一次英国职工大会的会议上进行了讨论。

entries.meaningZh: NatWest：英国银行名称
entries.en: Her NatWest statement arrived with the rent receipt.
entries.zh: 她的NatWest银行对账单和租金收据一起寄到了。

entries.meaningZh: NRA：National Register of Archives，英国档案登记索引名称；本例为档案语境
entries.en: An NRA reference helped her locate the family's old papers.
entries.zh: 一个国家档案登记索引号帮助她找到了家族的旧文件。

entries.meaningZh: Fujitsu：富士通，企业名称
entries.en: The office replaced an ageing Fujitsu scanner.
entries.zh: 办公室更换了一台老旧的富士通扫描仪。

entries.meaningZh: wha：苏格兰及部分英语方言中who的形式，谁
entries.en: Wha left the gate open? the farmer asked.
entries.zh: 谁把大门敞着？农夫问道。

entries.meaningZh: hath：have的古式第三人称单数现在时形式，相当于has
entries.en: The old letter begins, 'My brother hath sent good news.'
entries.zh: 那封旧信开头写道：我的兄弟已传来好消息。

entries.meaningZh: NED：牛津英语词典早期名称的缩写；历史语境
entries.en: She checked the quotation in an early volume of the NED.
entries.zh: 她在牛津英语词典的一册早期卷本中查核了那条引文。

entries.meaningZh: light的过去式、过去分词：点燃；本例为过去式
entries.en: She lighted a candle and carried it upstairs.
entries.zh: 她点燃一支蜡烛，拿着它上了楼。

entries.meaningZh: MCC：main communication centre，主通信中心；本例为系统中的缩写
entries.en: The warning reached the MCC before the local office received it.
entries.zh: 当地办公室收到警报前，主通信中心已经收到了。

entries.meaningZh: ITN：Independent Television News，英国独立电视新闻机构名称
entries.en: The interview appeared in an ITN news report.
entries.zh: 这段采访出现在一则ITN新闻报道中。

entries.meaningZh: AV：audiovisual，视听的；本例为设备用途
entries.en: The technician tested the AV equipment before the lecture.
entries.zh: 技术人员在讲座前测试了视听设备。

entries.meaningZh: CEGB：Central Electricity Generating Board，英国历史电力机构名称
entries.en: The archive held a CEGB map of the old power station.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着一张英国原中央发电局绘制的旧电站地图。

entries.meaningZh: ESRC：Economic and Social Research Council，英国经济与社会研究理事会；选用研究资助语境
entries.en: The team prepared an application for ESRC research funding.
entries.zh: 研究团队准备了一份经济与社会研究理事会的研究资助申请。

entries.meaningZh: NVQ：National Vocational Qualification，英国职业资格名称
entries.en: She studied for an NVQ while working at the nursery.
entries.zh: 她在托儿所工作的同时攻读职业资格。

entries.meaningZh: CDU：central display unit，中央显示单元；本例采用设备义
entries.en: The CDU showed the readings from all three sensors.
entries.zh: 中央显示单元显示了三个传感器的读数。

entries.meaningZh: WO：warrant officer，准尉；本例为军衔缩写
entries.en: The duty list placed WO Harris in charge of the stores.
entries.zh: 值勤表安排哈里斯准尉负责物资库。

entries.meaningZh: dup：POSIX中用于复制文件描述符的函数名（计算机语境）
entries.en: The program called dup to obtain another descriptor for the open file.
entries.zh: 程序调用dup，为已打开的文件取得另一个描述符。

entries.meaningZh: WI：Women's Institute，英国妇女组织名称；本例为组织语境
entries.en: The village WI organised a sale of homemade cakes.
entries.zh: 村里的妇女协会组织了一场自制蛋糕义卖。

entries.meaningZh: Thu.：Thursday的缩写，星期四
entries.en: The timetable shows the next collection on Thu.
entries.zh: 时间表显示下一次收取安排在星期四。

entries.meaningZh: VEN：Venezuela的国家代码；此处用于标记
entries.en: The results table listed the runner's country as VEN.
entries.zh: 成绩表将这名跑步选手的国家标为委内瑞拉。

entries.meaningZh: qqv：拉丁语quae vide的缩写，参见多个所列条目；书面索引用法
entries.en: The note ends with 'qqv', directing readers to the entries just named.
entries.zh: 那条注释以qqv结尾，指引读者参看刚列出的几个条目。

entries.meaningZh: patronising：自以为高人一等、以恩人姿态待人的；英式拼写
entries.en: Her patronising tone made a simple offer of help sound insulting.
entries.zh: 她那居高临下的语气，让一句简单的帮忙提议也听起来像侮辱。

entries.meaningZh: snapper：鲷类食用鱼；本例采用鱼名义
entries.en: The cook served grilled snapper with rice and lime.
entries.zh: 厨师端上了配有米饭和青柠的烤鲷鱼。

entries.meaningZh: charing：char作家务清扫、做钟点清洁时的-ing形式；不同于charring炭化
entries.en: She earned extra money by charing in the neighbouring houses.
entries.zh: 她在邻近几户人家做钟点清洁，赚些外快。

entries.meaningZh: CPA：certified public accountant，注册会计师；另选常见职业义
entries.en: We asked a CPA to review the business accounts.
entries.zh: 我们请一位注册会计师审阅企业账目。

entries.meaningZh: pre-：在……之前，预先；原词库词头未带连字符
entries.en: The children attended preschool before entering primary school.
entries.zh: 这些孩子上小学前先读了学前班。

entries.meaningZh: Kew：伦敦地名，常见于Kew Gardens邱园；首字母应大写
entries.en: We spent the afternoon walking through the gardens at Kew.
entries.zh: 我们下午在邱园的园林中散步。

entries.meaningZh: coursework：课程学习中的作业、项目等平时考核内容
entries.en: The final grade includes both coursework and an exam.
entries.zh: 最终成绩包括平时课程作业和一场考试。

entries.meaningZh: alamo：白杨、棉白杨；地区性植物名称
entries.en: A tall alamo shaded the edge of the dusty track.
entries.zh: 一棵高大的白杨在尘土路旁投下树荫。

entries.meaningZh: Slade：斯莱德，姓氏；本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dr Slade left the annotated map on the desk.
entries.zh: 斯莱德博士把带注释的地图留在了书桌上。

entries.meaningZh: ADHD：attention deficit hyperactivity disorder，注意缺陷多动障碍
entries.en: The school worked with the family to support a child with ADHD.
entries.zh: 学校与家长合作，为一名患有注意缺陷多动障碍的孩子提供支持。

entries.meaningZh: OBE：Officer of the Order of the British Empire，英帝国勋章的一种等级或荣衔
entries.en: The programme listed the guest as Margaret Lane OBE.
entries.zh: 节目单上将嘉宾列为玛格丽特·莱恩，OBE勋衔获得者。

entries.meaningZh: Aries的非标准拼写形式aires；本例使用标准词形Aries，白羊座
entries.en: The chart placed Aries at the beginning of the zodiac.
entries.zh: 那张图表把白羊座放在黄道十二宫的开端。

entries.meaningZh: MRI：magnetic resonance imaging，磁共振成像
entries.en: The clinic sent her the appointment time for her MRI.
entries.zh: 诊所把她接受磁共振检查的预约时间发给了她。

entries.meaningZh: centralisation：集中化、集权化；英式拼写
entries.en: The centralisation of purchasing reduced the number of separate orders.
entries.zh: 采购集中化减少了分散下单的次数。

entries.meaningZh: steelhead：降海洄游型虹鳟的名称；本例为鱼名
entries.en: The angler released the steelhead after taking a photograph.
entries.zh: 钓鱼人拍了一张照片后，便放走了那条虹鳟。

entries.meaningZh: und-：表示波、水的构词成分；本例见undulation
entries.en: A gentle undulation moved across the surface of the water.
entries.zh: 一道轻柔的波动掠过水面。

entries.meaningZh: Archibald：阿奇博尔德，人名；本例另选首字母大写的人名用法
entries.en: Archibald arrived with a parcel wrapped in brown paper.
entries.zh: 阿奇博尔德带着一个用牛皮纸包裹的包裹到了。

entries.meaningZh: CBS：美国哥伦比亚广播机构名称的缩写
entries.en: The interview was recorded for a CBS programme.
entries.zh: 这段采访是为CBS的一档节目录制的。

entries.meaningZh: Davy：戴维，姓氏；本例为英国化学家Humphry Davy的人名用法
entries.en: Our class read a biography of Humphry Davy before visiting the science museum.
entries.zh: 我们班参观科学博物馆前读了一本汉弗里·戴维的传记。

entries.meaningZh: Hants：Hampshire的传统缩写，英国汉普郡
entries.en: The parcel was addressed to a village in Hants.
entries.zh: 包裹寄往英国汉普郡的一个村庄。

entries.meaningZh: AMIS：acquisition management information system，采集管理信息系统；本例为系统缩写
entries.en: The librarian entered the new orders in AMIS.
entries.zh: 图书管理员把新订单录入了采集管理信息系统。

entries.meaningZh: deutsche：德语中与德国有关的形式；本例用于Deutsche Bank德意志银行这一专名
entries.en: The payment receipt showed the name Deutsche Bank.
entries.zh: 付款回执上显示了德意志银行的名称。

entries.meaningZh: clint：坚硬、突出的岩块或岩脊；地区性地貌用语
entries.en: A small fern grew in a crack beside the clint.
entries.zh: 一株小蕨生长在那块突出岩石旁的裂缝里。

entries.meaningZh: decentralisation：分散化、权力下放；英式拼写
entries.en: Decentralisation allowed each branch to choose its own opening hours.
entries.zh: 权力下放使各分支机构能够自行决定营业时间。

entries.meaningZh: Shane：谢恩，人名；本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Shane offered to carry the heavier suitcase.
entries.zh: 谢恩主动提出搬那个更重的行李箱。

entries.meaningZh: layup：篮球上篮；另选常见体育义
entries.en: She scored with a quick layup before the defenders could react.
entries.zh: 防守队员还没反应过来，她就快速上篮得分了。

entries.meaningZh: UV：ultraviolet，紫外线或紫外的
entries.en: The UV lamp was switched off before the cover was opened.
entries.zh: 打开盖子前，紫外灯已经关闭。

entries.meaningZh: pugh：表示厌恶或轻蔑的感叹词，类似呸；较少见用法
entries.en: Pugh! That cupboard smells of damp socks.
entries.zh: 呸！那只柜子里一股湿袜子的味道。

entries.meaningZh: JC：jurisconsult的缩写，法学家、法律顾问
entries.en: The archive identifies the author as a JC who advised the city council.
entries.zh: 档案将作者列为一名曾向市议会提供咨询的法学家。

entries.meaningZh: ay：aye的异体，用于表决时表示赞成
entries.en: Ay, I support the proposal to repair the bridge.
entries.zh: 赞成，我支持修缮这座桥的提案。

entries.meaningZh: CAL：computer-assisted learning，计算机辅助学习
entries.en: CAL allowed the students to practise pronunciation at their own pace.
entries.zh: 计算机辅助学习让学生能够按自己的进度练习发音。

entries.meaningZh: SF：science fiction，科幻小说或科幻作品
entries.en: The library moved its SF collection to a larger room.
entries.zh: 图书馆把科幻作品藏书搬到了一个更大的房间。

entries.meaningZh: Maude：女子名，注意首字母大写
entries.en: Maude kept a spare umbrella beside the front door.
entries.zh: 莫德在前门旁放了一把备用雨伞。

entries.meaningZh: 评定者；评分者
entries.en: Two independent raters assessed each student's presentation.
entries.zh: 每名学生的演讲都由两位独立评分者评定。

entries.meaningZh: num：number的缩写，数字或编号，常用于代码及表格字段
entries.en: The num field contains the number of tickets requested.
entries.zh: num字段记录所申请的票数。

entries.meaningZh: iPhone：苹果公司出品的智能手机，品牌名按此形式书写
entries.en: She used her iPhone to photograph the handwritten shopping list.
entries.zh: 她用iPhone拍下了手写购物清单。

entries.meaningZh: CJ：Chief Justice，首席法官
entries.en: The case summary lists the presiding judge as the CJ.
entries.zh: 案件摘要将主持审理的法官列为首席法官。

entries.meaningZh: SEN：special educational needs，特殊教育需要
entries.en: The school provides extra support for pupils with SEN.
entries.zh: 学校为有特殊教育需要的学生提供额外支持。

entries.meaningZh: TC：task control，任务控制，计算机语境
entries.en: The TC component assigns pending jobs to available processors.
entries.zh: 任务控制组件将待处理作业分配给可用处理器。

entries.meaningZh: bae：俚语，对恋人或亲近之人的昵称，类似宝贝
entries.en: I'm meeting bae for dinner after work.
entries.zh: 下班后我要和我的宝贝一起吃晚饭。

entries.meaningZh: Ames：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Professor Ames left detailed comments on the first draft.
entries.zh: 埃姆斯教授在初稿上留下了详细评语。

entries.meaningZh: LCC：life-cycle cost，全寿命周期成本
entries.en: The cheaper machine had a higher LCC because it needed frequent repairs.
entries.zh: 便宜的机器因需要频繁维修，全寿命周期成本反而更高。

entries.meaningZh: thingy：口语中一时想不起名称的东西、那个玩意儿
entries.en: Could you pass me the little metal thingy beside the screwdriver?
entries.zh: 你能把螺丝刀旁边那个小金属玩意儿递给我吗？

entries.meaningZh: lil：little的非正式缩写，常见于聊天或昵称
entries.en: I need a lil break before we start the next round.
entries.zh: 开始下一轮之前，我得稍微休息一下。

entries.meaningZh: Utd：United的缩写，常用于足球队名称
entries.en: The scoreboard showed City leading Utd by one goal.
entries.zh: 记分牌显示城队领先联队一球。

entries.meaningZh: EPA：Environmental Protection Agency，美国环境保护署
entries.en: The report cites EPA guidance on monitoring air quality.
entries.zh: 报告引用了美国环境保护署关于空气质量监测的指导文件。

entries.meaningZh: Jos：人名，本例用作虚构人物名，首字母大写
entries.en: Jos offered to carry the heavy box upstairs.
entries.zh: 乔斯主动提出把沉重的箱子搬上楼。

entries.meaningZh: OPCS：Office of Population Censuses and Surveys，英国原人口普查与调查局
entries.en: The historian compared the figures with an older OPCS publication.
entries.zh: 历史学家把这些数字与英国原人口普查与调查局较早的一份出版物作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: Mackie：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Mrs Mackie grows tomatoes in pots on her balcony.
entries.zh: 麦基太太在阳台的花盆里种番茄。

entries.meaningZh: GDR：German Democratic Republic，德意志民主共和国的历史缩写
entries.en: The exhibition includes posters printed in the GDR during the 1980s.
entries.zh: 展览中有二十世纪八十年代在德意志民主共和国印制的海报。

entries.meaningZh: Supt：superintendent的缩写，主管或警务职衔
entries.en: The notice was signed by Supt Harris, who was overseeing the investigation.
entries.zh: 通知由负责监督调查的哈里斯警司签署。

entries.meaningZh: 杏仁糖膏；用杏仁和糖制成、可用于装饰糕点的食品
entries.en: She shaped the marzipan into tiny pears to decorate the cake.
entries.zh: 她把杏仁糖膏捏成小梨，用来装饰蛋糕。

entries.meaningZh: UDC：Universal Decimal Classification，国际十进分类法
entries.en: The librarian used UDC to arrange the technical reports by subject.
entries.zh: 图书管理员利用国际十进分类法，按主题排列技术报告。

entries.meaningZh: coli：大肠杆菌学名Escherichia coli中的种加词，常见写法E. coli
entries.en: The laboratory tested the water sample for E. coli.
entries.zh: 实验室检测了水样中是否存在大肠杆菌。

entries.meaningZh: BOM：bill of materials，物料清单
entries.en: Before ordering the parts, check the BOM against the latest design.
entries.zh: 订购零件前，请根据最新设计核对物料清单。

entries.meaningZh: Kruger：姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dr Kruger asked the team to label every sample clearly.
entries.zh: 克鲁格博士要求团队把每份样品都标记清楚。

entries.meaningZh: ibn：阿拉伯语姓名中的组成部分，表示某人之子
entries.en: In the name Hasan ibn Ali, ibn indicates that Hasan is the son of Ali.
entries.zh: 在Hasan ibn Ali这个姓名中，ibn表示哈桑是阿里的儿子。

entries.meaningZh: BMC：bulk moulding compound，团状模塑料
entries.en: The casing was moulded from BMC to obtain a rigid, heat-resistant shape.
entries.zh: 外壳由团状模塑料模制而成，以获得坚硬且耐热的形状。

entries.meaningZh: Sheff：Sheffield的非正式缩写，谢菲尔德
entries.en: The fixture list shortened Sheffield to Sheff to save space.
entries.zh: 赛程表为了节省空间，把Sheffield缩写成Sheff。

entries.meaningZh: LM：lunar module，登月舱
entries.en: The museum displayed a model of the LM beside the mission photographs.
entries.zh: 博物馆在任务照片旁展出了一件登月舱模型。

entries.meaningZh: PWR：pressurised water reactor，压水反应堆
entries.en: The diagram shows how a PWR transfers heat through a separate water circuit.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了压水反应堆如何通过独立的水回路传递热量。

entries.meaningZh: SSD：solid-state drive，固态硬盘
entries.en: Replacing the old hard drive with an SSD made the laptop start much faster.
entries.zh: 把旧硬盘换成固态硬盘后，笔记本电脑启动快了许多。

entries.meaningZh: CAMRA：Campaign for Real Ale，英国争取传统啤酒运动组织
entries.en: He found the pub in a guide published by CAMRA.
entries.zh: 他在CAMRA出版的一本指南中找到了这家酒馆。

entries.meaningZh: fn：function的缩写，函数，常用于程序代码
entries.en: The fn parameter accepts a function that converts each input value.
entries.zh: fn参数接收一个用于转换各输入值的函数。

entries.meaningZh: WHE：water hammer eliminator，水锤消除器，工程缩写
entries.en: The plumbing drawing marks the water hammer eliminator as WHE.
entries.zh: 管道图纸把水锤消除器标记为WHE。

entries.meaningZh: 哎哟；表示突然感到疼痛
entries.en: Ow! That pan handle is still hot.
entries.zh: 哎哟！那个锅柄还烫着呢。

entries.meaningZh: LIFFE：London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange，伦敦国际金融期货及期权交易所的历史名称
entries.en: The dissertation examines contracts once traded on LIFFE.
entries.zh: 这篇学位论文研究曾在伦敦国际金融期货及期权交易所交易的合约。

entries.meaningZh: Lok：人名或姓氏，本例用作虚构人物名
entries.en: Lok checked the map before choosing the path along the river.
entries.zh: 洛克在选择沿河的小路之前查看了地图。

entries.meaningZh: WEU：Western European Union，西欧联盟的历史缩写
entries.en: The researcher consulted WEU documents from the period after the war.
entries.zh: 研究者查阅了战后时期的西欧联盟文件。

entries.meaningZh: sched：schedule的非正式缩略形式，时间表或安排
entries.en: Can you check tomorrow's sched before booking the meeting room?
entries.zh: 预订会议室前，你能看一下明天的安排吗？

entries.meaningZh: Tsu：日本城市津市的英语名称
entries.en: They stopped in Tsu on their journey through central Japan.
entries.zh: 他们途经日本中部时在津市停留。

entries.meaningZh: 兽人；奇幻故事中的一种类人怪物
entries.en: An orc guarded the narrow bridge in the fantasy game.
entries.zh: 在这款奇幻游戏里，一名兽人守着狭窄的桥。

entries.meaningZh: ARDS：acute respiratory distress syndrome，急性呼吸窘迫综合征
entries.en: The lecture explained the difference between ARDS and a mild chest infection.
entries.zh: 讲座解释了急性呼吸窘迫综合征与轻度胸部感染的区别。

entries.meaningZh: NCT：non-contact tonometer，非接触式眼压计
entries.en: The optometrist used an NCT to measure the pressure inside each eye.
entries.zh: 验光师用非接触式眼压计测量了双眼的眼内压。

entries.meaningZh: LFA：last field address，最后字段地址，计算机缩写
entries.en: The debugging display labels the last field address as LFA.
entries.zh: 调试界面将最后字段地址标记为LFA。

entries.meaningZh: ECR：engineering change request，工程更改申请
entries.en: The engineer submitted an ECR after discovering that the bracket did not fit.
entries.zh: 工程师发现支架不合适后，提交了一份工程更改申请。

entries.meaningZh: Jinny：女子名，本例用作虚构人物名
entries.en: Jinny wrapped the seedlings carefully before taking them to school.
entries.zh: 金妮把幼苗仔细包好，随后带去了学校。

entries.meaningZh: rever：法语rêver省略重音符号的形式，意为做梦；不作为常用英语动词使用
entries.en: I dreamed of a garden with a stream running through it.
entries.zh: 我梦见了一座有溪流穿过的花园。

entries.meaningZh: ACH：automated clearing house，自动清算所或自动清算系统
entries.en: The company pays its suppliers through ACH transfers.
entries.zh: 这家公司通过自动清算系统转账向供应商付款。

entries.meaningZh: 不关心他人的；冷漠的
entries.en: His uncaring reply made her reluctant to ask for help again.
entries.zh: 他冷漠的答复使她不愿再开口求助。

entries.meaningZh: oversee的过去分词，监督、管理
entries.en: The restoration has been overseen by an experienced conservation team.
entries.zh: 修复工作一直由一支经验丰富的文物保护团队监督。

entries.meaningZh: 小指，亦拼作pinkie，非正式用语
entries.en: He caught his pinky in the drawer and quickly pulled his hand away.
entries.zh: 他的小指被抽屉夹了一下，便迅速把手抽开。

entries.meaningZh: 使熟悉；familiarize的英式拼写
entries.en: Please familiarise yourself with the emergency exits before the tour begins.
entries.zh: 参观开始前，请先熟悉紧急出口的位置。

entries.meaningZh: Sethe：人名，本例用作虚构人物名
entries.en: Sethe placed a clean cloth over the basket of warm bread.
entries.zh: 塞丝在装着热面包的篮子上盖了一块干净的布。

entries.meaningZh: 大肠菌群的；与大肠菌群有关的
entries.en: The technician recorded the coliform count for each water sample.
entries.zh: 技术员记录了每份水样的大肠菌群计数。

entries.meaningZh: focuss：旧数据中的非标准词形；现代标准词头为focus，意为集中注意力或调焦
entries.en: Try to focus on one task instead of switching between three screens.
entries.zh: 试着专注于一项任务，而不要在三个屏幕之间来回切换。

entries.meaningZh: 产生幻觉；感知到实际上不存在的事物
entries.en: The exhausted traveller began to hallucinate after several nights without sleep.
entries.zh: 疲惫的旅行者连续几个晚上没睡后，开始产生幻觉。

entries.meaningZh: 二百周年的
entries.en: The town organised a bicentennial parade to mark its two hundredth anniversary.
entries.zh: 镇上组织了一场二百周年纪念游行，庆祝建镇两百年。

entries.meaningZh: VC：venture capital，风险投资
entries.en: The startup raised VC funding to develop its first working prototype.
entries.zh: 这家初创公司获得了风险投资，用于开发第一个可运行的原型。

entries.meaningZh: 森林的；与森林有关的，较少用词
entries.en: The survey records changes in forestal vegetation along the mountain slopes.
entries.zh: 调查记录了山坡上森林植被的变化。

entries.meaningZh: Chatham：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Chatham volunteered to take the early shift at the shelter.
entries.zh: 查塔姆自愿在收容所值早班。

entries.meaningZh: 使制度化；使成为惯例，institutionalize的英式拼写
entries.en: The organisation hopes to institutionalise regular consultation with local residents.
entries.zh: 该组织希望把定期征询当地居民意见确立为制度。

entries.meaningZh: Wilhelm：德语男子名，英语对应William
entries.en: Wilhelm carefully restored the wooden frame of his grandfather's bicycle.
entries.zh: 威廉仔细修复了祖父那辆自行车的木质车架。

entries.meaningZh: Rodgers：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Captain Rodgers checked the weather forecast before leaving the harbour.
entries.zh: 罗杰斯船长出港前查看了天气预报。

entries.meaningZh: que：旧词库误拼，本义应为queue，队列；现代英语请使用queue
entries.en: A long queue formed outside the ticket office before it opened.
entries.zh: 售票处开门前，外面就排起了长队。

entries.meaningZh: Petri：见Petri dish，培养皿；Petri为姓氏，通常大写
entries.en: The student placed the sample in a sterile Petri dish.
entries.zh: 学生把样品放进了无菌培养皿。

entries.meaningZh: 抹灰用的长刮板、靠尺，建筑用语
entries.en: The plasterer drew a darby across the wall to level the wet plaster.
entries.zh: 抹灰工用长刮板刮过墙面，将湿灰泥抹平。

entries.meaningZh: topo：topographic map的非正式缩略说法，地形图
entries.en: We checked the topo before choosing a route over the ridge.
entries.zh: 我们先查看地形图，再选择翻越山脊的路线。

entries.meaningZh: 糟糕的；质量差的，非正式用语
entries.en: We left the crummy hotel after discovering that the heating did not work.
entries.zh: 发现暖气坏了之后，我们离开了那家糟糕的旅馆。

entries.meaningZh: QUI：quantitative ultrasound index，定量超声指数
entries.en: The research table reports the QUI alongside the other ultrasound measurements.
entries.zh: 研究表格在其他超声测量值旁列出了定量超声指数。

entries.meaningZh: Adler：姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dr Adler asked whether anyone had noticed a change in the river's colour.
entries.zh: 阿德勒博士问，是否有人注意到了河水颜色的变化。

entries.meaningZh: Michelin：米其林，品牌及指南名称
entries.en: The restaurant received a star in the latest Michelin guide.
entries.zh: 这家餐馆在最新版米其林指南中获得了一颗星。

entries.meaningZh: 社会人口特征的，如年龄、收入及教育程度等方面的
entries.en: The study compared attendance across several sociodemographic groups.
entries.zh: 研究比较了若干具有不同社会人口特征的群体的出勤情况。

entries.meaningZh: 挑衅地；故意引起强烈反应地
entries.en: He provocatively questioned whether the committee had achieved anything at all.
entries.zh: 他挑衅地质疑委员会究竟有没有取得任何成果。

entries.meaningZh: Burnett：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Burnett saved the receipt in case the appliance needed to be returned.
entries.zh: 伯内特留着收据，以防需要退回这件电器。

entries.meaningZh: 锦标赛；比赛，tournament的较旧或文学性说法
entries.en: Teams from six villages gathered for the summer tourney.
entries.zh: 六个村庄的队伍聚集在一起，参加夏季锦标赛。

entries.meaningZh: Wolfe：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Ms Wolfe paused the recording so that everyone could take notes.
entries.zh: 沃尔夫女士暂停了录音，好让大家做笔记。

entries.meaningZh: 使合法化；使具有正当性，legitimize的英式拼写
entries.en: An election cannot legitimise a decision if voters are denied a genuine choice.
entries.zh: 如果选民没有真正的选择权，选举也不能赋予一项决定正当性。

entries.meaningZh: Eccles：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Eccles found a bundle of old letters behind the kitchen drawer.
entries.zh: 埃克尔斯在厨房抽屉后面发现了一捆旧信。

entries.meaningZh: admin：administration的非正式缩写，行政事务或管理工作
entries.en: I spend the first hour of each Monday catching up on admin.
entries.zh: 每周一的头一个小时，我都用来处理积压的行政事务。

entries.meaningZh: 沿墙设置的软垫长座椅，常见于餐厅
entries.en: We sat on a curved banquette near the restaurant window.
entries.zh: 我们坐在餐厅窗边一张弧形的软垫长座椅上。

entries.meaningZh: Formica：福米加塑料贴面材料的商标名
entries.en: The old kitchen table had a pale blue Formica top.
entries.zh: 那张旧厨房桌子的桌面贴着浅蓝色福米加塑料贴面。

entries.meaningZh: 昆虫的刺；蜇刺器官
entries.en: The bee left its stinger in the thick gardening glove.
entries.zh: 蜜蜂把刺留在了厚厚的园艺手套里。

entries.meaningZh: 适应新的气候或环境，acclimatize的英式拼写
entries.en: We spent two days at the lower camp to acclimatise before climbing higher.
entries.zh: 继续向上攀登之前，我们在较低的营地待了两天以适应环境。

entries.meaningZh: Ludlow：英语姓氏或地名，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Ludlow repaired the broken latch instead of replacing the whole gate.
entries.zh: 勒德洛修好了坏门闩，没有更换整扇大门。

entries.meaningZh: Cornell：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Cornell put the fragile parcel on the top shelf, beyond the dog's reach.
entries.zh: 康奈尔把易碎包裹放在最上层架子上，让狗够不着。

entries.meaningZh: airforce：词库中的连写形式；通常写作air force，空军
entries.en: Her brother joined the air force after finishing university.
entries.zh: 她哥哥大学毕业后加入了空军。

entries.meaningZh: oy：用于引起注意或表示不满的感叹词，英式非正式用语
entries.en: Oy! You've left your backpack on the bus.
entries.zh: 喂！你把背包落在公交车上了。

entries.meaningZh: 睡眠；小睡，英式非正式用语
entries.en: I need a quick kip before driving home tonight.
entries.zh: 今晚开车回家前，我需要先小睡一会儿。

entries.meaningZh: Eiffel：埃菲尔，见Eiffel Tower，埃菲尔铁塔
entries.en: We could see the Eiffel Tower from the window of our hotel room.
entries.zh: 从酒店房间的窗户可以看到埃菲尔铁塔。

entries.meaningZh: Denton：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Denton drew a rough plan of the garden on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 丹顿在信封背面画了一张花园的草图。

entries.meaningZh: Hermes：赫尔墨斯，希腊神话中的神
entries.en: The museum's label describes Hermes as a messenger of the gods.
entries.zh: 博物馆的说明牌把赫尔墨斯介绍为诸神的信使。

entries.meaningZh: 计算机化；使用计算机处理原有业务，computerization的英式拼写
entries.en: Computerisation reduced the time needed to retrieve old patient records.
entries.zh: 计算机化缩短了查找旧病历所需的时间。

entries.meaningZh: Spalding：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Spalding brought an extra pair of gloves for the winter hike.
entries.zh: 斯波尔丁为冬季徒步多带了一副手套。

entries.meaningZh: Magdalene：女子名，本例用作虚构人物名
entries.en: Magdalene taught the children how to fold paper boats.
entries.zh: 玛格达琳教孩子们折纸船。

entries.meaningZh: Fenwick：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Fenwick listened to both sides before suggesting a compromise.
entries.zh: 芬威克听取双方意见后，提出了一个折中方案。

entries.meaningZh: 动态地；随着情况变化而调整地
entries.en: The application dynamically resizes the images to fit the screen.
entries.zh: 应用程序动态调整图片大小，以适应屏幕。

entries.meaningZh: Hepburn：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Mrs Hepburn lent me a cookbook with handwritten notes in the margins.
entries.zh: 赫本太太借给我一本食谱，页边写着手写笔记。

entries.meaningZh: Ewing：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Ewing stayed behind to help stack the chairs after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，尤因留下来帮忙把椅子叠好。

entries.meaningZh: 元认知的；涉及对自身思考或学习过程的认识和调控的
entries.en: Keeping a learning journal can encourage metacognitive reflection.
entries.zh: 写学习日志有助于促进对自身学习过程的元认知反思。

entries.meaningZh: 古代斯堪的纳维亚的；古诺尔斯语的
entries.en: The manuscript preserves several stories from Norse mythology.
entries.zh: 这份手稿保存了几个北欧神话故事。

entries.meaningZh: 硬质纤维板；由压制木纤维制成的板材
entries.en: He cut a sheet of hardboard to fit the back of the cupboard.
entries.zh: 他把一张硬质纤维板裁好，装在橱柜背面。

entries.meaningZh: Yuri：男子名，本例用作虚构人物名
entries.en: Yuri carried the telescope outside once the clouds had cleared.
entries.zh: 云散后，尤里把望远镜搬到了室外。

entries.meaningZh: Bottome：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Bottome donated a box of illustrated books to the community library.
entries.zh: 博顿向社区图书馆捐了一箱插图书。

entries.meaningZh: panty：女式内裤，通常使用复数panties
entries.en: She packed several pairs of panties in a separate travel pouch.
entries.zh: 她把几条女式内裤装在一个单独的旅行袋里。

entries.meaningZh: Perez：佩雷斯，姓氏，西班牙语形式常写作Pérez
entries.en: Perez translated the welcome message for the visiting students.
entries.zh: 佩雷斯为来访学生翻译了欢迎词。

entries.meaningZh: 霍比特人；托尔金奇幻作品中的一种矮小人形种族成员
entries.en: The child dressed as a hobbit for the school costume parade.
entries.zh: 孩子打扮成霍比特人，参加学校的化装游行。

entries.meaningZh: BEL：计算机字符中的响铃控制字符名
entries.en: The terminal produced a short beep when it received the BEL character.
entries.zh: 终端收到BEL响铃控制字符时，发出了一声短促的提示音。

entries.meaningZh: Audi：奥迪，汽车品牌
entries.en: They rented an Audi for the journey across the mountains.
entries.zh: 他们租了一辆奥迪，驾车穿越山区。

entries.meaningZh: Dryden：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dryden wrote down the address before the phone battery ran out.
entries.zh: 手机电量耗尽之前，德赖登记下了地址。

entries.meaningZh: RSA：Republic of South Africa，南非共和国
entries.en: The historical document uses RSA as an abbreviation for the Republic of South Africa.
entries.zh: 这份历史文献用RSA指代南非共和国。

entries.meaningZh: Nielsen：姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Nielsen adjusted the microphone so the audience could hear the question.
entries.zh: 尼尔森调整了麦克风，好让听众听清问题。

entries.meaningZh: Brookes：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Brookes kept a small notebook of unfamiliar words while travelling.
entries.zh: 旅行时，布鲁克斯用一本小笔记本记录生词。

entries.meaningZh: luv：love的非正式拼写，可作亲昵称呼
entries.en: Are you all right, luv? You look a little tired.
entries.zh: 亲爱的，你还好吗？你看起来有点累。

entries.meaningZh: coombe：山谷、山间谷地，亦拼作combe，英国地形用语
entries.en: A narrow stream wound through the sheltered coombe.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的溪流蜿蜒穿过避风的山谷。

entries.meaningZh: 在制度上；从机构层面看
entries.en: The scheme was institutionally supported but depended on volunteers to operate.
entries.zh: 这项计划得到了机构层面的支持，但运作仍依赖志愿者。

entries.meaningZh: mmmm：表示食物美味或满足感的拟声感叹写法
entries.en: Mmmm, this soup tastes even better than it smells.
entries.zh: 嗯，真香，这汤喝起来比闻着还好。

entries.meaningZh: Dunne：英语姓氏，本例用作虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dunne arrived early to reserve a quiet table near the window.
entries.zh: 邓恩早早到达，订下了窗边一张安静的桌子。

entries.meaningZh: RS：reset，复位，设备或计算机语境
entries.en: Pressing RS resets the counter to zero.
entries.zh: 按下RS键会把计数器复位为零。

entries.meaningZh: Tay：泰河，苏格兰河流名称
entries.en: Mist rose from the Tay before sunrise.
entries.zh: 日出前，泰河上升起了薄雾。

entries.meaningZh: 博士后研究人员，非正式用语
entries.en: A postdoc helped us calibrate the laboratory equipment.
entries.zh: 一名博士后研究人员帮我们校准了实验室设备。

entries.meaningZh: hast：have与thou搭配的旧式现在时形式，表示有或已
entries.en: Thou hast kept thy promise despite the danger.
entries.zh: 尽管有危险，你仍履行了诺言。

entries.meaningZh: Avignon：阿维尼翁，法国城市
entries.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring Avignon.
entries.zh: 我们在一个下雨的下午游览了阿维尼翁。

entries.meaningZh: Alma：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Alma tucked the letter inside her diary.
entries.zh: 阿尔玛把信夹进了日记本。

entries.meaningZh: PLA：programmable logic array，可编程逻辑阵列
entries.en: The engineer implemented the control logic on a PLA.
entries.zh: 工程师用可编程逻辑阵列实现了控制逻辑。

entries.meaningZh: 挥鞭伤；颈部突然甩动造成的损伤
entries.en: He suffered whiplash when another car hit his vehicle from behind.
entries.zh: 另一辆车从后面撞上他的车，导致他颈部遭受挥鞭伤。

entries.meaningZh: 紫藤，一种开下垂花串的攀缘植物
entries.en: Purple wisteria hung above the garden entrance.
entries.zh: 紫色的紫藤花垂在花园入口上方。

entries.meaningZh: 健壮而有吸引力的，非正式用语
entries.en: The film cast a hunky actor as the lifeguard.
entries.zh: 影片让一位健壮迷人的演员扮演救生员。

entries.meaningZh: crocodile的口语简称，鳄鱼
entries.en: A croc lay motionless near the riverbank.
entries.zh: 一条鳄鱼一动不动地伏在河岸旁。

entries.meaningZh: Lumpur：见完整地名Kuala Lumpur，吉隆坡
entries.en: Our flight to Kuala Lumpur leaves at noon.
entries.zh: 我们飞往吉隆坡的航班中午起飞。

entries.meaningZh: AKA：also known as，也叫、又称
entries.en: The performer, AKA Silver Fox, wore a bright red jacket.
entries.zh: 这位又名银狐的表演者穿着一件鲜红色外套。

entries.meaningZh: 雷鸟，北美部分原住民传统中的神话鸟
entries.en: A thunderbird appears in the story carved on the pole.
entries.zh: 柱子上雕刻的故事中出现了一只雷鸟。

entries.meaningZh: Hayden：人名或姓氏，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Hayden collected the fallen branches after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨后，海登收集了掉落的树枝。

entries.meaningZh: Yt：钇的旧化学符号；现代标准符号为Y
entries.en: The old chemistry chart used Yt where a modern chart uses Y.
entries.zh: 旧化学图表在现代图表使用Y的地方写着Yt。

entries.meaningZh: 按个人需要定制，customize的英式拼写
entries.en: You can customise the toolbar to show your favourite commands.
entries.zh: 你可以定制工具栏，显示最常用的命令。

entries.meaningZh: 经常追逐不同女性的男子；风流男子，贬义
entries.en: She refused to date a man with a reputation as a womanizer.
entries.zh: 她拒绝与一个以风流出名的男人约会。

entries.meaningZh: Lund：隆德，瑞典城市
entries.en: She travelled to Lund for an academic conference.
entries.zh: 她前往隆德参加学术会议。

entries.meaningZh: knapp：knap的异体，敲击石料、打制燧石
entries.en: The craftsperson demonstrated how to knap flint into a sharp tool.
entries.zh: 工匠演示了如何敲打燧石，将它制成锋利的工具。

entries.meaningZh: Thom：人名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Thom tightened the straps on his backpack.
entries.zh: 汤姆收紧了背包带。

entries.meaningZh: 零碎的；缺乏连贯性的，英式用语
entries.en: The report felt bitty because its sections did not connect.
entries.zh: 报告各部分缺少衔接，显得零零碎碎。

entries.meaningZh: Defoe：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Defoe marked the damaged tiles with chalk.
entries.zh: 笛福用粉笔标出了破损的瓷砖。

entries.meaningZh: 钻研某领域细节的人，尤指政策研究者；非正式用语
entries.en: A policy wonk explained the proposal's less obvious consequences.
entries.zh: 一位政策研究专家解释了这项提案中不太明显的后果。

entries.meaningZh: 二十多岁的人
entries.en: The flat was shared by three twentysomethings.
entries.zh: 三个二十多岁的年轻人合租了这套公寓。

entries.meaningZh: Olsen：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Olsen wrapped the glass vase in newspaper.
entries.zh: 奥尔森用报纸包好了玻璃花瓶。

entries.meaningZh: Starr：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Starr offered to proofread the invitation.
entries.zh: 斯塔尔主动提出校对邀请函。

entries.meaningZh: nee：née的无重音写法，用在女性婚前姓氏前，表示原姓
entries.en: The record lists her as Anna Brown, nee Miller.
entries.zh: 记录把她列为安娜·布朗，原姓米勒。

entries.meaningZh: 重新表述；重新制定或调整配方
entries.en: The reformulation made the question easier to understand.
entries.zh: 重新表述后，这个问题更容易理解了。

entries.meaningZh: 令人庆幸地；幸好
entries.en: The house was blessedly quiet after the guests left.
entries.zh: 客人离开后，屋里安静得令人庆幸。

entries.meaningZh: 端庄地；娴静地
entries.en: She smiled demurely and accepted the compliment.
entries.zh: 她娴静地微笑，接受了赞美。

entries.meaningZh: Corsica：科西嘉岛，地中海岛屿
entries.en: They took a ferry to Corsica in early summer.
entries.zh: 初夏时，他们乘渡轮去了科西嘉岛。

entries.meaningZh: 钳子，通常用复数pliers
entries.en: He used a pair of pliers to pull out the bent nail.
entries.zh: 他用一把钳子拔出了弯钉子。

entries.meaningZh: 偶然；机缘，旧式或文学用语
entries.en: By good hap, a fisherman was nearby when the boat overturned.
entries.zh: 幸而船翻的时候，一位渔夫恰好就在附近。

entries.meaningZh: Dior：迪奥，品牌名称
entries.en: The exhibition included a vintage Dior dress.
entries.zh: 展览中有一条迪奥古着连衣裙。

entries.meaningZh: Hawthorne：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Hawthorne left fresh water for the stray cat.
entries.zh: 霍桑给流浪猫留了干净的水。

entries.meaningZh: 靠有限的自身资源逐步建立或发展
entries.en: They bootstrapped the company with savings from their previous jobs.
entries.zh: 他们用以前工作积攒的钱逐步创办了这家公司。

entries.meaningZh: Eastman：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Eastman photographed the valley at first light.
entries.zh: 天刚亮，伊斯特曼就拍下了山谷的景色。

entries.meaningZh: Cicero：西塞罗，古罗马政治家与演说家
entries.en: The essay compares Cicero's speeches with later political rhetoric.
entries.zh: 文章将西塞罗的演说与后来的政治修辞作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: Lena：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Lena packed sandwiches for the train journey.
entries.zh: 莉娜为火车旅行准备了三明治。

entries.meaningZh: 参加某种活动的人，常用于复合词，如cinema-goer
entries.en: As a regular cinema-goer, she recognised the director's style.
entries.zh: 作为经常看电影的人，她认出了这位导演的风格。

entries.meaningZh: Ogden：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Ogden measured the doorway before buying the sofa.
entries.zh: 奥格登买沙发前量了门口的尺寸。

entries.meaningZh: Kitchener：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Kitchener sorted the donated clothes by size.
entries.zh: 基奇纳把捐来的衣物按尺码分好。

entries.meaningZh: 不久；一会儿，旧式或文学用语
entries.en: Wait here, and I shall return anon.
entries.zh: 在这里等着，我一会儿就回来。

entries.meaningZh: Erwin：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Erwin put the repaired clock back on the mantelpiece.
entries.zh: 欧文把修好的钟放回了壁炉架。

entries.meaningZh: Wm：William的传统姓名缩写
entries.en: The signature reads Wm Carter, with William abbreviated.
entries.zh: 签名写的是Wm Carter，其中William用了缩写。

entries.meaningZh: 南侧；城镇或地区的南部，常也分写为south side
entries.en: They opened a bakery on the southside of town.
entries.zh: 他们在镇南开了一家面包店。

entries.meaningZh: Riga：里加，拉脱维亚首都
entries.en: We explored Riga on foot rather than hiring a car.
entries.zh: 我们步行游览了里加，没有租车。

entries.meaningZh: GE：General Electric，通用电气的缩写
entries.en: The old appliance still carried a GE label.
entries.zh: 这台旧电器仍贴着通用电气的标签。

entries.meaningZh: Chopin：肖邦，波兰作曲家与钢琴家
entries.en: She played a Chopin nocturne at the recital.
entries.zh: 她在独奏会上演奏了一首肖邦夜曲。

entries.meaningZh: JM：Juris Master，法律硕士学位的缩写，具体名称以授予机构为准
entries.en: The brochure describes a JM programme designed for non-lawyers.
entries.zh: 宣传册介绍了一个面向非法律专业人士的法律硕士项目。

entries.meaningZh: taxy：taxi的异体，飞机在地面滑行；现代通常用taxi
entries.en: The aircraft began to taxi towards the runway.
entries.zh: 飞机开始向跑道滑行。

entries.meaningZh: 影响精神活动的；作用于心理或精神状态的
entries.en: The review examined the use of psychotropic medication in the study.
entries.zh: 综述考察了研究中精神活性药物的使用情况。

entries.meaningZh: AJ：anti-jamming，抗干扰的技术缩写
entries.en: The specification lists the receiver's AJ capability separately.
entries.zh: 规格书单独列出了接收器的抗干扰能力。

entries.meaningZh: Schwartz：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Schwartz noticed a discrepancy between the two invoices.
entries.zh: 施瓦茨注意到两张发票之间存在不一致。

entries.meaningZh: NZ：New Zealand，新西兰
entries.en: The parcel was sent from NZ to Australia.
entries.zh: 包裹从新西兰寄往了澳大利亚。

entries.meaningZh: Nikki：人名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Nikki chose the shorter trail because rain was forecast.
entries.zh: 因为预报有雨，尼基选择了较短的步道。

entries.meaningZh: Hannibal：汉尼拔，人名；本例指迦太基统帅
entries.en: The class discussed Hannibal's campaign across the Alps.
entries.zh: 课堂上讨论了汉尼拔翻越阿尔卑斯山的战役行动。

entries.meaningZh: Siena：锡耶纳，意大利城市
entries.en: We arrived in Siena just before sunset.
entries.zh: 我们在日落前不久抵达了锡耶纳。

entries.meaningZh: BM：British Museum，大英博物馆的缩写
entries.en: The catalogue credits the BM for lending the object.
entries.zh: 目录注明该展品由大英博物馆出借。

entries.meaningZh: Gaston：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Gaston replaced the missing button on his coat.
entries.zh: 加斯顿给外套补上了掉落的扣子。

entries.meaningZh: BSA：bovine serum albumin，牛血清白蛋白
entries.en: The laboratory used BSA as a protein standard.
entries.zh: 实验室用牛血清白蛋白作为蛋白质标准品。

entries.meaningZh: squaw：旧时称北美原住民女性的词，现被视为冒犯性称呼，不宜称呼他人
entries.en: The editor removed the offensive word squaw from the modern edition.
entries.zh: 编辑从现代版本中删去了带有冒犯性的squaw一词。

entries.meaningZh: 骑士；某些骑士勋章的受勋者
entries.en: The portrait shows a chevalier wearing his ceremonial sash.
entries.zh: 肖像中，一位骑士佩戴着礼仪绶带。

entries.meaningZh: Britannica：见Encyclopaedia Britannica，大英百科全书
entries.en: I checked the historical date in Britannica.
entries.zh: 我在大英百科全书中核对了这个历史日期。

entries.meaningZh: 一窝动物中最弱小的一只
entries.en: The runt of the litter needed extra feeding.
entries.zh: 这一窝中最弱小的幼崽需要额外喂养。

entries.meaningZh: 开玩笑地；逗弄地
entries.en: She teasingly asked whether he had forgotten his own birthday.
entries.zh: 她开玩笑地问，他是不是忘了自己的生日。

entries.meaningZh: arsehole：粗俗用语，肛门；也用于辱骂讨厌的人，英式拼写
entries.en: He called the driver an arsehole, then regretted losing his temper.
entries.zh: 他骂那个司机是个混蛋，随后后悔自己发了脾气。

entries.meaningZh: Weiss：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Weiss tested the microphone before the lecture.
entries.zh: 魏斯在讲座开始前测试了麦克风。

entries.meaningZh: COM：computer output microfilm，计算机输出缩微胶片
entries.en: The archive stores older transaction records on COM.
entries.zh: 档案馆用计算机输出缩微胶片保存较早的交易记录。

entries.meaningZh: 对技术或某种爱好非常着迷的；带书呆子气的，非正式用语
entries.en: His geeky enthusiasm for old computers was contagious.
entries.zh: 他对老式计算机那种痴迷的热情感染了大家。

entries.meaningZh: Damon：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Damon checked the tyre pressure before the long drive.
entries.zh: 长途开车前，达蒙检查了轮胎气压。

entries.meaningZh: Crispin：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Crispin carried the injured bird to a wildlife centre.
entries.zh: 克里斯平把受伤的鸟送到了野生动物救护中心。

entries.meaningZh: 可视化；用图像呈现数据或形成心理图像，visualization的英式拼写
entries.en: The visualisation revealed a pattern hidden in the raw data.
entries.zh: 可视化图像揭示了原始数据中不易察觉的规律。

entries.meaningZh: Ave：avenue的地址缩写，大街或林荫道
entries.en: The delivery address was 18 Maple Ave.
entries.zh: 送货地址是枫树大街18号。

entries.meaningZh: Pilate：彼拉多，历史人名
entries.en: The course examines accounts of Pilate in ancient sources.
entries.zh: 课程考察了古代文献中有关彼拉多的记载。

entries.meaningZh: Welles：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Welles helped hang the paintings before the gallery opened.
entries.zh: 画廊开门前，韦尔斯帮忙挂好了画。

entries.meaningZh: OOO：out of office，不在办公室，常见于工作消息
entries.en: Her calendar was marked OOO for the whole afternoon.
entries.zh: 她整个下午的日历状态都标为不在办公室。

entries.meaningZh: PCC：program-controlled computer，程序控制计算机
entries.en: The training manual refers to the program-controlled computer as the PCC.
entries.zh: 培训手册将程序控制计算机简称为PCC。

entries.meaningZh: Sacramento：萨克拉门托，美国加利福尼亚州首府
entries.en: They stopped for lunch in Sacramento.
entries.zh: 他们在萨克拉门托停下来吃午饭。

entries.meaningZh: Pompey：庞培，古罗马将领与政治家
entries.en: The biography describes Pompey's rivalry with Caesar.
entries.zh: 这本传记描写了庞培与凯撒之间的竞争。

entries.meaningZh: 可以实现的；可变现的，realizable的英式拼写
entries.en: The valuation lists each asset at its estimated realisable value.
entries.zh: 估值表按预计可变现价值列出了每项资产。

entries.meaningZh: 熟悉澳大利亚丛林或偏远地区生活的人；本例不指族群称呼
entries.en: An experienced bushman showed them how to find water.
entries.zh: 一位熟悉丛林生活的人教他们寻找水源。

entries.meaningZh: Marcia：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Marcia organised the photographs by year.
entries.zh: 玛西娅把照片按年份整理好。

entries.meaningZh: Crusoe：见Robinson Crusoe，鲁滨逊·克鲁索，小说人物
entries.en: The students discussed how Crusoe adapted to life on the island.
entries.zh: 学生们讨论了鲁滨逊如何适应岛上的生活。

entries.meaningZh: 骰子或纸牌上的五点，较少用词
entries.en: The player rolled a cinque and moved five spaces.
entries.zh: 玩家掷出了五点，向前移动了五格。

entries.meaningZh: RCA：Radio Corporation of America，美国无线电公司的历史名称
entries.en: The collector found an old RCA radio at the market.
entries.zh: 收藏者在市场上发现了一台老式RCA收音机。

entries.meaningZh: 在方法上；从研究方法角度看
entries.en: The two studies differ methodologically despite asking similar questions.
entries.zh: 两项研究虽然提出了相似的问题，但在研究方法上有所不同。

entries.meaningZh: bono：见pro bono，免费为公益提供专业服务，源自拉丁语
entries.en: The lawyer agreed to handle the case pro bono.
entries.zh: 律师同意免费办理此案，以提供公益法律服务。

entries.meaningZh: Decca：台卡，见历史上的Decca导航系统
entries.en: The chart records position fixes obtained with the Decca system.
entries.zh: 海图记录了通过台卡导航系统获得的定位点。

entries.meaningZh: overthrow的过去式，推翻
entries.en: The uprising overthrew the government within a week.
entries.zh: 起义在一周内推翻了政府。

entries.meaningZh: Dortmund：多特蒙德，德国城市
entries.en: She changed trains in Dortmund on her way north.
entries.zh: 她北上途中在多特蒙德换了火车。

entries.meaningZh: cps：characters per second，每秒字符数
entries.en: The printer's speed was measured in cps.
entries.zh: 这台打印机的速度以每秒字符数来衡量。

entries.meaningZh: Kinsey：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Kinsey kept the seedlings away from direct sunlight.
entries.zh: 金西把幼苗放在没有阳光直射的地方。

entries.meaningZh: 猫；对猫的亲昵称呼
entries.en: Come here, puss; your supper is ready.
entries.zh: 小猫，过来，你的晚饭好了。

entries.meaningZh: RW：read-write，可读写，计算机语境
entries.en: The drive was mounted in RW mode so files could be updated.
entries.zh: 驱动器以可读写模式挂载，因此可以更新文件。

entries.meaningZh: Heywood：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Heywood held the ladder while I cleared the gutter.
entries.zh: 我清理檐沟时，海伍德扶着梯子。

entries.meaningZh: Ince：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Ince returned the borrowed tools before closing time.
entries.zh: 因斯在关门前归还了借来的工具。

entries.meaningZh: FP：floating point，浮点数或浮点运算
entries.en: The benchmark compares integer performance with FP performance.
entries.zh: 基准测试比较了整数运算与浮点运算的性能。

entries.meaningZh: Emanuel：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Emanuel practised the difficult passage slowly.
entries.zh: 伊曼纽尔慢速练习了那个难演奏的乐段。

entries.meaningZh: 可向客户计费的
entries.en: Travel time is not billable under this contract.
entries.zh: 根据这份合同，路途时间不能向客户计费。

entries.meaningZh: Justinian：查士丁尼，拜占庭皇帝名
entries.en: The lecture examined legal reforms under Justinian.
entries.zh: 讲座考察了查士丁尼统治时期的法律改革。

entries.meaningZh: DUC：digital upconverter，数字上变频器
entries.en: The DUC shifts the signal to a higher frequency before transmission.
entries.zh: 数字上变频器在发送前将信号移至更高频率。

entries.meaningZh: 与其他人交换性伴侣的人，通常用于复数swingers；成人语境
entries.en: The article discusses how swingers negotiate boundaries with their partners.
entries.zh: 文章讨论了交换性伴侣者如何与伴侣协商界限。

entries.meaningZh: 电子合成器，乐器；synthesizer的英式拼写
entries.en: She used a synthesiser to create the film's eerie background music.
entries.zh: 她用电子合成器制作了影片中诡异的背景音乐。

entries.meaningZh: 由引力作用地；在引力方面
entries.en: The two stars are gravitationally bound to each other.
entries.zh: 这两颗恒星在引力作用下相互束缚。

entries.meaningZh: wah：哇音效果，常见于电吉他音色处理
entries.en: He added wah to the guitar solo with a foot pedal.
entries.zh: 他用脚踏效果器为吉他独奏加入了哇音。

entries.meaningZh: Juventus：尤文图斯，意大利足球俱乐部名称
entries.en: She wore a Juventus scarf to watch the match.
entries.zh: 她戴着尤文图斯围巾观看比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 灭虫器，尤指通过电击灭虫的装置，非正式用语
entries.en: A bug zapper hung above the porch.
entries.zh: 门廊上方挂着一台电击灭虫器。

entries.meaningZh: 现金流；亦写作cash flow
entries.en: Late payments caused a serious cashflow problem.
entries.zh: 付款延误造成了严重的现金流问题。

entries.meaningZh: Una：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Una saved a seat beside her for the new student.
entries.zh: 乌娜在身旁给新同学留了一个座位。

entries.meaningZh: Lara：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Lara checked the ingredients before ordering dessert.
entries.zh: 拉拉点甜点前查看了配料。

entries.meaningZh: PJ：见PJs，pyjamas的非正式缩写，睡衣
entries.en: He was still in his PJs when the parcel arrived.
entries.zh: 包裹送来时，他还穿着睡衣。

entries.meaningZh: 劫持汽车；以暴力或威胁夺走有人乘坐的车辆
entries.en: The gang tried to carjack a vehicle at the traffic lights.
entries.zh: 这伙人试图在红绿灯处劫持一辆车。

entries.meaningZh: SG：specific gravity，相对密度的常见缩写
entries.en: The results table lists SG alongside temperature.
entries.zh: 结果表在温度旁列出了相对密度。

entries.meaningZh: 拍卖行；拍卖厅，尤用于英式英语
entries.en: The painting will appear in a London saleroom next month.
entries.zh: 这幅画下个月将在伦敦的一家拍卖行亮相。

entries.meaningZh: Halstead：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Halstead locked the workshop before leaving.
entries.zh: 霍尔斯特德离开前锁好了工坊。

entries.meaningZh: -ville：用于地名等名称中的后缀，源自法语城镇
entries.en: The fictional town of Pineville lies beside a lake.
entries.zh: 虚构小镇派恩维尔坐落在湖边。

entries.meaningZh: LWT：London Weekend Television，伦敦周末电视的历史缩写
entries.en: The archive contains programmes originally made by LWT.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着最初由伦敦周末电视制作的节目。

entries.meaningZh: 斯瓦米；印度教宗教导师或修行者的尊称
entries.en: A visiting swami spoke about meditation at the community centre.
entries.zh: 一位来访的印度教导师在社区中心讲解了冥想。

entries.meaningZh: Salomon：人名或姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Salomon compared the two maps carefully.
entries.zh: 萨洛蒙仔细比较了两张地图。

entries.meaningZh: 纬线；织布时横向穿过经线的线
entries.en: She passed the weft through the loom by hand.
entries.zh: 她用手把纬线穿过织机。

entries.meaningZh: JF：人名首字母组合，本例为虚构署名
entries.en: The unsigned sketch bore only the initials JF.
entries.zh: 这张没有完整署名的素描上只写着首字母JF。

entries.meaningZh: Waitrose：维特罗斯，英国连锁超市名称
entries.en: I bought the ingredients at Waitrose on my way home.
entries.zh: 回家路上，我在维特罗斯买了食材。

entries.meaningZh: Fordham：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Fordham repaired the puncture beside the road.
entries.zh: 福德姆在路边补好了轮胎。

entries.meaningZh: CSO：chief security officer，首席安全官
entries.en: The CSO presented the organisation's new security policy.
entries.zh: 首席安全官介绍了机构的新安全政策。

entries.meaningZh: DAR：Daughters of the American Revolution，美国革命女儿会
entries.en: The historian consulted records held by the DAR.
entries.zh: 历史学家查阅了美国革命女儿会保存的记录。

entries.meaningZh: vid：video的非正式缩略形式，视频
entries.en: I sent you a short vid of the puppy playing.
entries.zh: 我给你发了一段小狗玩耍的视频。

entries.meaningZh: Bab：女子名或昵称，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Bab brought homemade biscuits to the meeting.
entries.zh: 巴布把自制饼干带到了会议上。

entries.meaningZh: 行为主义，一种重视可观察行为的心理学取向
entries.en: The course contrasts behaviourism with cognitive approaches to learning.
entries.zh: 课程将行为主义与学习的认知取向作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: party的现在分词，聚会、狂欢
entries.en: They stayed out partying until the last train had gone.
entries.zh: 他们在外面聚会狂欢，直到末班车都开走了。

entries.meaningZh: zomby：zombie的异体拼写，僵尸；现代通常写zombie
entries.en: A zombie lurched through the deserted street in the film.
entries.zh: 电影中，一具僵尸蹒跚着穿过空无一人的街道。

entries.meaningZh: Dorling：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Dorling labelled the seed packets with the planting dates.
entries.zh: 道林在种子袋上标注了播种日期。

entries.meaningZh: duffle：duffel的异体，厚呢；常见于duffle coat，粗呢大衣
entries.en: She wore a duffle coat with wooden toggles.
entries.zh: 她穿着一件有木质搭扣的粗呢大衣。

entries.meaningZh: Herpe：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Herpe sketched the roofline from across the square.
entries.zh: 埃尔普从广场对面画下了屋顶轮廓。

entries.meaningZh: 没有搜查令或逮捕令的，法律语境
entries.en: The court considered whether the warrantless search was lawful.
entries.zh: 法院审查了这次无搜查令搜查是否合法。

entries.meaningZh: aww：表示觉得可爱、感动或同情的感叹词
entries.en: Aww, the kitten has fallen asleep in your shoe.
entries.zh: 哎呀，小猫在你的鞋子里睡着了。

entries.meaningZh: WP：word processing，文字处理
entries.en: The computer course included basic WP skills.
entries.zh: 计算机课程包括基本的文字处理技能。

entries.meaningZh: Rainer：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Rainer tuned the violin before rehearsal.
entries.zh: 赖纳在排练前给小提琴调了音。

entries.meaningZh: IRS：Internal Revenue Service，美国国税局
entries.en: The accountant checked the latest IRS instructions.
entries.zh: 会计查阅了美国国税局的最新说明。

entries.meaningZh: 圆锥形帐篷；亦拼作tepee或tipi
entries.en: Smoke rose through the opening at the top of the teepee.
entries.zh: 烟从圆锥形帐篷顶端的开口升起。

entries.meaningZh: NCB：network control block，网络控制块
entries.en: The program allocated an NCB before opening the network session.
entries.zh: 程序在打开网络会话前分配了一个网络控制块。

entries.meaningZh: Hg：汞的化学符号，注意大写H、小写g
entries.en: The laboratory inventory lists mercury under the symbol Hg.
entries.zh: 实验室清单把汞列在化学符号Hg之下。

entries.meaningZh: SDS：safety data sheet，安全数据表
entries.en: Read the SDS before handling the cleaning chemical.
entries.zh: 处理这种清洁化学品前，请阅读安全数据表。

entries.meaningZh: yd：yard，码，长度单位的缩写
entries.en: The fabric label gives the price per yd.
entries.zh: 布料标签标出了每码的价格。

entries.meaningZh: 询问地；探询地，inquiringly的英式异体
entries.en: She looked at him enquiringly when he stopped speaking.
entries.zh: 他停下不说时，她用探询的目光看着他。

entries.meaningZh: BTR：back tape reader，旧式回带阅读机的缩写
entries.en: The maintenance diagram labels the back tape reader as BTR.
entries.zh: 维修图将回带阅读机标为BTR。

entries.meaningZh: UBS：瑞银，金融机构名称
entries.en: The report cites an analysis published by UBS.
entries.zh: 报告引用了瑞银发布的一项分析。

entries.meaningZh: ODA：official development assistance，官方发展援助
entries.en: The chart compares ODA spending across donor countries.
entries.zh: 图表比较了各援助国的官方发展援助支出。

entries.meaningZh: 社会测量的；用于研究群体中人际关系结构的
entries.en: The sociometric survey asked pupils whom they preferred to work with.
entries.zh: 社会测量调查询问学生更愿意与谁合作。

entries.meaningZh: Watney：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Watney checked every window before the storm arrived.
entries.zh: 暴风雨到来前，沃特尼检查了每一扇窗。

entries.meaningZh: terre：法语土地、大地，见借用短语pied-à-terre，临时落脚的小住所
entries.en: They kept a small pied-à-terre near the station.
entries.zh: 他们在车站附近保留了一处小小的临时住所。

entries.meaningZh: Kell：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Kell turned the radio down to hear the announcement.
entries.zh: 凯尔调低了收音机音量，以便听清通知。

entries.meaningZh: RAO：right anterior oblique，右前斜位，医学影像用语
entries.en: The image is labelled RAO to indicate the viewing position.
entries.zh: 图像标有RAO，用来表示右前斜位的观察位置。

entries.meaningZh: hoo：感叹或呼喊声，常见于woo-hoo等组合
entries.en: Woo-hoo! We finally reached the summit.
entries.zh: 哇，太好了！我们终于到达了山顶。

entries.meaningZh: 山体；山块，相对独立的一组山峰
entries.en: Snow covered the highest peaks of the massif.
entries.zh: 积雪覆盖着这片山体的最高峰。

entries.meaningZh: ln：自然对数的数学记号
entries.en: Taking ln of both sides turns the product into a sum.
entries.zh: 对两边取自然对数，可以把乘积转化为和。

entries.meaningZh: RHS：right-hand side，方程或表达式的右边
entries.en: Move the constant to the RHS of the equation.
entries.zh: 把常数移到方程右边。

entries.meaningZh: IDE：integrated development environment，集成开发环境
entries.en: The IDE highlighted the missing bracket before I ran the program.
entries.zh: 我运行程序之前，集成开发环境就标出了缺失的括号。

entries.meaningZh: dev：developer的非正式简称，软件开发者
entries.en: A senior dev helped me understand the unfamiliar code.
entries.zh: 一位资深开发者帮助我理解了不熟悉的代码。

entries.meaningZh: lbw：leg before wicket，板球中的腿前出局
entries.en: The umpire gave the batter out lbw.
entries.zh: 裁判判该击球手腿前出局。

entries.meaningZh: Ur：乌尔，美索不达米亚古城名
entries.en: The exhibition displays objects excavated at Ur.
entries.zh: 展览陈列了在乌尔出土的物品。

entries.meaningZh: Goa：果阿，印度的一个邦
entries.en: They spent a week in Goa before travelling inland.
entries.zh: 他们在果阿待了一周，随后前往内陆。

entries.meaningZh: 衣着老气、不时髦的
entries.en: The oversized coat made the otherwise elegant outfit look frumpy.
entries.zh: 过大的外套让原本优雅的穿搭显得老气。

entries.meaningZh: NL：newline，换行，计算机语境
entries.en: The parser treats NL as the end of a record.
entries.zh: 解析器把换行符视为一条记录的结束。

entries.meaningZh: 鹟，一类捕食飞虫的鸟
entries.en: A flycatcher darted from the branch to catch an insect.
entries.zh: 一只鹟从树枝上飞出，捕捉了一只昆虫。

entries.meaningZh: SCROL：semicustom chip row-organized layout，半定制芯片行结构版图的专业缩写
entries.en: The design note expands SCROL as semicustom chip row-organized layout.
entries.zh: 设计说明将SCROL展开为半定制芯片行结构版图。

entries.meaningZh: DSC：differential scanning calorimetry，差示扫描量热法
entries.en: DSC revealed a change in the polymer's thermal behaviour.
entries.zh: 差示扫描量热法揭示了这种聚合物热行为的变化。

entries.meaningZh: ILO：International Labour Organization，国际劳工组织
entries.en: The researchers used employment data from the ILO.
entries.zh: 研究人员使用了国际劳工组织的就业数据。

entries.meaningZh: ADT：abstract data type，抽象数据类型
entries.en: A stack is an ADT with push and pop operations.
entries.zh: 栈是一种具有入栈和出栈操作的抽象数据类型。

entries.meaningZh: Ara：人名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Ara brought a spare charger for the trip.
entries.zh: 阿拉为这次旅行多带了一个充电器。

entries.meaningZh: ICM：ischemic cardiomyopathy，缺血性心肌病
entries.en: The study compared patients with ICM and those with other heart conditions.
entries.zh: 研究比较了缺血性心肌病患者与患有其他心脏疾病的人。

entries.meaningZh: 单簧管演奏者，亦拼作clarinettist
entries.en: The clarinetist played a gentle solo over the strings.
entries.zh: 单簧管演奏者在弦乐伴奏之上吹奏了一段轻柔的独奏。

entries.meaningZh: Youngs：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Youngs traced the loose wire to the switch.
entries.zh: 扬斯沿着松动的电线找到了开关。

entries.meaningZh: 可胜任多个位置的球员，尤指篮球中的锋卫摇摆人
entries.en: The coach values a swingman who can defend both guards and forwards.
entries.zh: 教练看重能同时防守后卫和前锋的锋卫摇摆人。

entries.meaningZh: Collin：男子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Collin left a note explaining where the spare key was.
entries.zh: 科林留了一张便条，说明备用钥匙放在哪里。

entries.meaningZh: UAE：United Arab Emirates，阿拉伯联合酋长国
entries.en: The company opened a regional office in the UAE.
entries.zh: 公司在阿拉伯联合酋长国设立了区域办公室。

entries.meaningZh: EB：electron beam，电子束
entries.en: The diagram shows an EB striking the metal surface.
entries.zh: 示意图显示一束电子束撞击金属表面。

entries.meaningZh: magi：magus的复数，古代东方的祭司或智者；也指圣经中的东方贤士
entries.en: The painting depicts the Magi bringing gifts.
entries.zh: 这幅画描绘了东方贤士献礼的场景。

entries.meaningZh: IBF：International Boxing Federation，国际拳击联合会
entries.en: The boxer trained for an IBF title fight.
entries.zh: 拳手为一场国际拳击联合会的冠军争夺赛训练。

entries.meaningZh: MAU：media attachment unit，介质连接单元，网络硬件用语
entries.en: The technician replaced the faulty MAU before testing the network again.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了故障介质连接单元，然后重新测试网络。

entries.meaningZh: tri-：表示三、三个，如triangle中的构词成分
entries.en: A triangle has three sides and three angles.
entries.zh: 三角形有三条边和三个角。

entries.meaningZh: Cpl：corporal，下士的军衔缩写
entries.en: Cpl Evans checked that everyone had returned safely.
entries.zh: 埃文斯下士确认所有人都已安全返回。

entries.meaningZh: flt：flight的缩写，航班，常见于行程表
entries.en: The itinerary lists the return journey as flt 208.
entries.zh: 行程表将返程列为208号航班。

entries.meaningZh: GRE：Graduate Record Examinations，美国研究生入学考试
entries.en: She studied for the GRE while working part-time.
entries.zh: 她一边兼职，一边准备GRE考试。

entries.meaningZh: Clemens：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Clemens placed the repaired chair by the window.
entries.zh: 克莱门斯把修好的椅子放在窗边。

entries.meaningZh: 有海滩气息的；让人联想到海滩的，非正式用语
entries.en: Pale wood and woven mats gave the room a beachy feel.
entries.zh: 浅色木材和编织垫让房间有了海滩般的气息。

entries.meaningZh: 微观经济的；涉及个体或企业经济决策的
entries.en: The policy may have different microeconomic effects on small firms.
entries.zh: 这项政策可能对小企业产生不同的微观经济影响。

entries.meaningZh: IDB：Inter-American Development Bank，美洲开发银行
entries.en: The project received financing from the IDB.
entries.zh: 该项目获得了美洲开发银行的融资。

entries.meaningZh: PV：present value，现值
entries.en: The spreadsheet calculates the PV of the future payments.
entries.zh: 电子表格计算了未来付款的现值。

entries.meaningZh: Cho：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Cho checked the laboratory door twice before leaving.
entries.zh: 赵离开前检查了两次实验室的门。

entries.meaningZh: BNP：B-type natriuretic peptide，B型利钠肽
entries.en: The paper reports BNP levels alongside other clinical measurements.
entries.zh: 论文在其他临床测量数据旁报告了B型利钠肽水平。

entries.meaningZh: Jong：人名或姓名组成部分，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Jong offered his seat to an elderly passenger.
entries.zh: 钟把座位让给了一位年长乘客。

entries.meaningZh: Fourier：傅里叶，见Fourier transform，傅里叶变换
entries.en: A Fourier transform helps reveal the frequencies in the signal.
entries.zh: 傅里叶变换有助于显示信号中的频率成分。

entries.meaningZh: pw：per week，每周，常见于租金标价
entries.en: The advertisement lists the rent as £180 pw.
entries.zh: 广告列出的租金是每周180英镑。

entries.meaningZh: FRG：Federal Republic of Germany，德意志联邦共和国
entries.en: The archive contains trade reports issued by the FRG.
entries.zh: 档案中有德意志联邦共和国发布的贸易报告。

entries.meaningZh: Lowther：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Lowther drew the curtains to reduce the glare.
entries.zh: 劳瑟拉上窗帘，减弱刺眼的光线。

entries.meaningZh: 露天市场；集市，尤指阿拉伯地区的市场
entries.en: We bought spices from a stall in the souk.
entries.zh: 我们在集市的一个摊位上买了香料。

entries.meaningZh: WIV：working inverse voltage，反向工作电压的专业缩写
entries.en: The component table gives WIV in volts.
entries.zh: 元件表以伏特为单位列出了反向工作电压。

entries.meaningZh: APU：auxiliary power unit，辅助动力装置
entries.en: The aircraft's APU supplied power while it was parked.
entries.zh: 飞机停放时，由辅助动力装置供电。

entries.meaningZh: ith：数学排版中第i个的纯文本写法，通常记作i-th或带下标的形式
entries.en: The ith observation contributes one term to the sum.
entries.zh: 第i个观测值为这个总和贡献了一项。

entries.meaningZh: lx：lux，勒克斯，照度单位的符号
entries.en: The meter showed an illuminance of 500 lx.
entries.zh: 测量仪显示照度为500勒克斯。

entries.meaningZh: LTA：Lawn Tennis Association，英国草地网球协会
entries.en: The club consulted the LTA about coaching courses.
entries.zh: 俱乐部向英国草地网球协会咨询了教练培训课程。

entries.meaningZh: 友善；亲切；令人愉快的特质
entries.en: Her niceness made the new volunteers feel welcome.
entries.zh: 她的友善让新志愿者觉得自己受到了欢迎。

entries.meaningZh: EO：essential oil，精油，产品标签中的缩写
entries.en: The ingredient sheet defines EO as essential oil.
entries.zh: 配料表把EO解释为精油。

entries.meaningZh: Mallory：人名或姓氏，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Mallory carried the wet boots to the porch.
entries.zh: 马洛里把湿靴子拿到了门廊。

entries.meaningZh: OTC：over-the-counter，非处方的；本例指药物类别
entries.en: The survey asked about both prescription and OTC medicines.
entries.zh: 调查询问了处方药和非处方药的使用情况。

entries.meaningZh: 欧洲没药，亦称sweet cicely，一种芳香植物
entries.en: Sweet cicely grew beside the herb garden's stone path.
entries.zh: 香草园的石板路旁长着欧洲没药。

entries.meaningZh: Kempe：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Kempe examined the old bridge for cracks.
entries.zh: 肯普检查了旧桥是否有裂缝。

entries.meaningZh: FFR：fractional flow reserve，血流储备分数，医学测量指标
entries.en: The study recorded FFR values for each examined vessel.
entries.zh: 研究记录了每条受检血管的血流储备分数值。

entries.meaningZh: 超轻型飞机，英式英语
entries.en: A microlight flew low over the empty fields.
entries.zh: 一架超轻型飞机低空飞过空旷的田野。

entries.meaningZh: Rasa：女子名，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Rasa brought flowers from her garden.
entries.zh: 拉莎带来了自家花园里的花。

entries.meaningZh: GPA：grade point average，平均绩点
entries.en: Her GPA improved after she changed her study routine.
entries.zh: 改变学习习惯后，她的平均绩点提高了。

entries.meaningZh: 棕地的；曾开发利用、现拟重新开发的土地的
entries.en: The council plans to build homes on a brownfield site.
entries.zh: 市议会计划在一块待重新开发的旧用地上建住宅。

entries.meaningZh: AGR：advanced gas-cooled reactor，先进气冷反应堆
entries.en: The model shows the main components of an AGR.
entries.zh: 模型展示了先进气冷反应堆的主要部件。

entries.meaningZh: bf：boyfriend的聊天缩写，男朋友
entries.en: My bf is picking me up after the concert.
entries.zh: 演唱会结束后，我男朋友会来接我。

entries.meaningZh: NN：neural network，神经网络
entries.en: The NN was trained on a separate dataset.
entries.zh: 这个神经网络使用单独的数据集进行了训练。

entries.meaningZh: 使杂交；杂交，hybridize的英式拼写
entries.en: The two plant varieties can hybridise naturally.
entries.zh: 这两个植物品种可以自然杂交。

entries.meaningZh: KP：kitchen police，军队厨房杂勤，亦称kitchen patrol
entries.en: He was assigned KP and spent the morning peeling potatoes.
entries.zh: 他被安排做厨房杂勤，整个上午都在削土豆皮。

entries.meaningZh: TQM：total quality management，全面质量管理
entries.en: The company introduced TQM to improve processes across departments.
entries.zh: 公司引入全面质量管理，以改进各部门的流程。

entries.meaningZh: 违宪地；以违反宪法的方式
entries.en: The court ruled that the authority had acted unconstitutionally.
entries.zh: 法院裁定，该机构的行为违反了宪法。

entries.meaningZh: McPhee：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: McPhee brought a spare battery for the camera.
entries.zh: 麦克菲为相机带了一块备用电池。

entries.meaningZh: seq：sequence的缩写，序列
entries.en: The seq column records the order in which the samples arrived.
entries.zh: seq列记录了样品到达的先后顺序。

entries.meaningZh: VL：virtual library，虚拟图书馆
entries.en: Students can access the VL from their own devices.
entries.zh: 学生可以用自己的设备访问虚拟图书馆。

entries.meaningZh: CCA：Canadian Construction Association，加拿大建筑协会
entries.en: The report cites a statement issued by the CCA.
entries.zh: 报告引用了加拿大建筑协会发布的一份声明。

entries.meaningZh: Occam：奥卡姆，见Occam's razor，奥卡姆剃刀原则
entries.en: Occam's razor favours the explanation that requires fewer unnecessary assumptions.
entries.zh: 奥卡姆剃刀原则倾向于选择所需额外假设更少的解释。

entries.meaningZh: Mx：不标示性别的英语称谓，置于姓名前
entries.en: Please address the letter to Mx Taylor.
entries.zh: 请把信的收件人称谓写成Mx Taylor。

entries.meaningZh: Quartier：姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Quartier checked the platform number before boarding.
entries.zh: 卡尔捷上车前核对了站台号。

entries.meaningZh: phylum的复数，生物分类中的门
entries.en: The diagram compares body plans across several animal phyla.
entries.zh: 示意图比较了几个动物门的身体结构类型。

entries.meaningZh: VO：voice-over，画外音或旁白
entries.en: The director recorded the VO after editing the final scene.
entries.zh: 导演剪好最后一场戏后录制了旁白。

entries.meaningZh: PSD：power spectral density，功率谱密度
entries.en: The PSD plot shows a strong peak near that frequency.
entries.zh: 功率谱密度图在该频率附近显示出一个明显峰值。

entries.meaningZh: 强有力地；稳健地
entries.en: The estimate remained robustly positive under different modelling assumptions.
entries.zh: 在不同建模假设下，这一估计值始终稳健地保持为正。

entries.meaningZh: DOI：digital object identifier，数字对象标识符
entries.en: Include the article's DOI so readers can locate it easily.
entries.zh: 请附上文章的数字对象标识符，方便读者查找。

entries.meaningZh: BRI：basic rate interface，基本速率接口，ISDN用语
entries.en: The technician connected the router to the BRI line.
entries.zh: 技术员把路由器接到了基本速率接口线路。

entries.meaningZh: SSAP：session service access point，会话服务访问点
entries.en: The protocol diagram identifies the SSAP at the session-layer boundary.
entries.zh: 协议图在会话层边界标出了会话服务访问点。

entries.meaningZh: -ing：构成现在分词、动名词等形式的后缀
entries.en: Reading before bed helps her relax.
entries.zh: 睡前阅读有助于她放松。

entries.meaningZh: Jez：人名或昵称，本例为虚构人物
entries.en: Jez volunteered to cook for the camping trip.
entries.zh: 杰兹自愿负责露营期间做饭。

entries.meaningZh: CLR：clear，清除，常见于按键或指令
entries.en: Press CLR to remove the previous entry.
entries.zh: 按CLR键可清除上一项输入。

entries.meaningZh: THI：temperature-humidity index，温湿指数
entries.en: The researchers calculated THI from the recorded temperature and humidity.
entries.zh: 研究人员根据记录的温度和湿度计算了温湿指数。

entries.meaningZh: ab：abdominal muscle的非正式简称，腹肌，常用复数abs
entries.en: The exercise targets the abs without requiring any equipment.
entries.zh: 这个动作无需器械，主要锻炼腹肌。

entries.meaningZh: SHO：senior house officer，英国医学培训体系中的旧职称，住院医师
entries.en: The older hospital record was signed by an SHO.
entries.zh: 这份较早的医院记录由一名住院医师签署。

entries.meaningZh: SRO：self-regulatory organisation，自律组织
entries.en: The SRO sets professional standards for its members.
entries.zh: 该自律组织为会员制定职业标准。

entries.meaningZh: NFL：National Football League，美国职业橄榄球大联盟
entries.en: He watches NFL games with his neighbours on Sundays.
entries.zh: 每逢星期日，他都和邻居一起看NFL比赛。

entries.meaningZh: 缺血；组织因供血不足而缺氧，ischemia的英式拼写
entries.en: The scan showed signs of ischaemia in the affected tissue.
entries.zh: 扫描显示受影响组织存在缺血迹象。

entries.meaningZh: ORF：open reading frame，开放阅读框，遗传学用语
entries.en: The analysis identified an ORF within the DNA sequence.
entries.zh: 分析在这段DNA序列中识别出了一个开放阅读框。

entries.meaningZh: sch：school的缩写，常见于表格或地图标注
entries.en: The old map marks the school simply as sch.
entries.zh: 旧地图仅用sch来标记学校。

entries.meaningZh: IWC：International Whaling Commission，国际捕鲸委员会
entries.en: The article summarises a recent IWC meeting.
entries.zh: 文章概述了国际捕鲸委员会最近的一次会议。

entries.meaningZh: Bonar：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Bonar left the gate open for the delivery van.
entries.zh: 博纳为送货车敞开了大门。

entries.meaningZh: 难以找到、抓住或理解的特性；难以捉摸
entries.en: The animal's elusiveness made it difficult to photograph.
entries.zh: 这种动物行踪难觅，很难拍到照片。

entries.meaningZh: clo：衡量衣服隔热性能的单位
entries.en: The table compares the clo values of several winter outfits.
entries.zh: 表格比较了几套冬季服装的隔热值。

entries.meaningZh: Minch：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Minch carried the folded tables into the hall.
entries.zh: 明奇把折叠桌搬进了大厅。

entries.meaningZh: LOE：level of effort，工作投入程度或工作量
entries.en: The proposal includes an estimate of the LOE for each task.
entries.zh: 提案估算了每项任务所需的工作量。

entries.meaningZh: HNC：Higher National Certificate，英国高等国家证书
entries.en: She completed an HNC in engineering while working.
entries.zh: 她在工作期间完成了工程类高等国家证书课程。

entries.meaningZh: sta：station的缩写，站或台，常见于图表标注
entries.en: The route plan labels the final stop as Central Sta.
entries.zh: 路线图把终点标为中央车站。

entries.meaningZh: UGT：Unión General de Trabajadores，西班牙工会组织名称的缩写
entries.en: The report includes comments from a UGT representative.
entries.zh: 报告收录了一位UGT工会代表的评论。

entries.meaningZh: NaOH：氢氧化钠的化学式，注意大小写
entries.en: The labelled bottle contained a dilute NaOH solution.
entries.zh: 贴有标签的瓶中装着稀氢氧化钠溶液。

entries.meaningZh: 富有成效地；有成果地
entries.en: The two teams collaborated fruitfully on the new design.
entries.zh: 两个团队就新设计进行了富有成效的合作。

entries.meaningZh: VMS：virtual memory system，虚拟存储系统；亦见相关操作系统名称
entries.en: The manual explains how the VMS manages memory allocation.
entries.zh: 手册解释了虚拟存储系统如何管理内存分配。

entries.meaningZh: CGA：Color Graphics Adapter，彩色图形适配器，旧式显示标准
entries.en: The vintage game offered a CGA graphics mode.
entries.zh: 这款老游戏提供了CGA图形显示模式。

entries.meaningZh: NSA：National Security Agency，美国国家安全局
entries.en: The journalist examined publicly released NSA documents.
entries.zh: 记者研究了美国国家安全局公开发布的文件。

entries.meaningZh: NEP：New Economic Policy，新经济政策；本例指苏俄历史政策
entries.en: The seminar examined the role of the NEP in the 1920s.
entries.zh: 研讨会考察了新经济政策在二十世纪二十年代的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 侠盗式的；充满大胆冒险和打斗的
entries.en: The film is a swashbuckling adventure set at sea.
entries.zh: 这是一部以海上为背景、充满大胆冒险和打斗的影片。

entries.meaningZh: ppl：people的聊天缩写，人们
entries.en: Only six ppl have replied in the group chat.
entries.zh: 群聊中只有六个人回复了。

entries.meaningZh: PNC：Palestinian National Council，巴勒斯坦全国委员会
entries.en: The article discusses a resolution adopted by the PNC.
entries.zh: 文章讨论了巴勒斯坦全国委员会通过的一项决议。

entries.meaningZh: Brugge：布鲁日的荷兰语名称，英语亦称Bruges
entries.en: We cycled along a canal outside Brugge.
entries.zh: 我们沿布鲁日城外的一条运河骑行。

entries.meaningZh: 不雅致的；笨拙的；缺乏巧妙之处的
entries.en: The solution worked, but the code was rather inelegant.
entries.zh: 解决办法有效，但代码相当不够简洁巧妙。

entries.meaningZh: AIB：Associate of the Institute of Bankers，银行家学会准会员资格的缩写
entries.en: The directory lists AIB among her professional qualifications.
entries.zh: 名录将银行家学会准会员资格列为她的专业资历之一。

entries.meaningZh: 莫卧儿的；与印度莫卧儿王朝有关的
entries.en: The museum displayed textiles from the Mughal period.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了莫卧儿时期的纺织品。

entries.meaningZh: maritima：拉丁语种加词的形式，表示海滨的，见植物学名Armeria maritima
entries.en: Armeria maritima grew between the coastal rocks.
entries.zh: 海滨岩石之间长着海石竹。

entries.meaningZh: Uda：人名或姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Uda tested the new lens in low light.
entries.zh: 宇田在弱光下测试了新镜头。

entries.meaningZh: ADN：adiponitrile，己二腈的专业缩写
entries.en: The process diagram uses ADN as shorthand for adiponitrile.
entries.zh: 工艺流程图用ADN作为己二腈的缩写。

entries.meaningZh: DSP：digital signal processor，数字信号处理器
entries.en: The DSP filters background noise from the recording.
entries.zh: 数字信号处理器滤除了录音中的背景噪声。

entries.meaningZh: 有鳍的鱼；区别于贝类等水产动物的鱼类
entries.en: The market sells both shellfish and finfish.
entries.zh: 这个市场既卖贝类，也卖有鳍鱼类。

entries.meaningZh: Qian：钱，汉语姓氏的拼音，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Qian compared the results from the two experiments.
entries.zh: 钱比较了两次实验的结果。

entries.meaningZh: Dra：Doctora的缩写，西班牙语女性博士或医生的称谓
entries.en: The Spanish invitation addresses the speaker as Dra López.
entries.zh: 这封西班牙语邀请函将讲者称为洛佩斯博士。

entries.meaningZh: TNC：transnational corporation，跨国公司
entries.en: The case study examines how a TNC manages overseas suppliers.
entries.zh: 案例研究考察了一家跨国公司如何管理海外供应商。

entries.meaningZh: 境外货币；存放在货币发行国以外银行的该国货币
entries.en: The lecture distinguished eurocurrency deposits from deposits denominated in euros.
entries.zh: 讲座区分了境外货币存款与以欧元计价的存款。

entries.meaningZh: PDC：primary domain controller，主域控制器，计算机网络用语
entries.en: The administrator checked the PDC after several login failures.
entries.zh: 多次登录失败后，管理员检查了主域控制器。

entries.meaningZh: MNR：mean neap rise，平均小潮升，水文用语
entries.en: The tide table lists MNR separately from the spring-tide figures.
entries.zh: 潮汐表将平均小潮升与大潮数据分开列示。

entries.meaningZh: 沼泽木；长期埋在泥炭沼泽中得以保存的木材
entries.en: The sculptor carved a small bowl from bogwood.
entries.zh: 雕刻家用沼泽木雕了一只小碗。

entries.meaningZh: stg：sterling，英镑，金融文件中的缩写
entries.en: The invoice gives the total as £500 stg.
entries.zh: 发票列出的总额为500英镑。

entries.meaningZh: Cockcroft：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Cockcroft adjusted the lamp to illuminate the workbench.
entries.zh: 科克罗夫特调了台灯，照亮工作台。

entries.meaningZh: 角响尾蛇；一种以侧向方式移动的沙漠响尾蛇
entries.en: A sidewinder left curved tracks across the sand.
entries.zh: 一条角响尾蛇在沙地上留下了弯曲的痕迹。

entries.meaningZh: BRM：biological response modifier，生物反应调节剂
entries.en: The review classifies the treatment as a BRM.
entries.zh: 综述将这种治疗归类为生物反应调节剂疗法。

entries.meaningZh: WID：women in development，妇女参与发展，发展研究用语
entries.en: The course compares WID with later approaches to gender and development.
entries.zh: 课程将妇女参与发展取向与后来的性别与发展取向作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: DCM：dilated cardiomyopathy，扩张型心肌病
entries.en: The registry includes patients diagnosed with DCM.
entries.zh: 登记库收录了被诊断为扩张型心肌病的患者。

entries.meaningZh: MNP：Microcom Networking Protocol，Microcom连网协议，旧式调制解调器用语
entries.en: The old modem manual describes its support for MNP.
entries.zh: 这本旧调制解调器手册介绍了设备对MNP协议的支持。

entries.meaningZh: Bundespost：德国联邦邮政的历史名称
entries.en: The collection includes stamps issued by the Bundespost.
entries.zh: 藏品中包括德国联邦邮政发行的邮票。

entries.meaningZh: BFS：breadth-first search，广度优先搜索
entries.en: BFS visits all nearby nodes before moving to the next level.
entries.zh: 广度优先搜索会先访问所有相邻节点，再前往下一层。

entries.meaningZh: KMT：Kuomintang，中国国民党的英语缩写
entries.en: The history essay examines the KMT's early organisation.
entries.zh: 这篇历史论文考察了国民党的早期组织。

entries.meaningZh: TPA：third-party administrator，第三方管理机构或管理人，保险等语境
entries.en: The insurer hired a TPA to handle claims paperwork.
entries.zh: 保险公司聘请第三方管理机构处理理赔文书。

entries.meaningZh: NEA：National Endowment for the Arts，美国国家艺术基金会
entries.en: The theatre applied for an NEA grant.
entries.zh: 剧院申请了美国国家艺术基金会的资助。

entries.meaningZh: SuperCalc：一款早期电子表格软件的名称
entries.en: The archive contains spreadsheets originally created in SuperCalc.
entries.zh: 档案中有最初用SuperCalc制作的电子表格。

entries.meaningZh: IgM：immunoglobulin M，免疫球蛋白M，注意大小写
entries.en: The assay measured IgM in the blood sample.
entries.zh: 这项检测测量了血样中的免疫球蛋白M。

entries.meaningZh: Frodo：弗罗多，托尔金小说中的人物名
entries.en: The reader followed Frodo's journey through the novel.
entries.zh: 读者随着小说追踪弗罗多的旅程。

entries.meaningZh: 詹姆斯党主义；支持恢复斯图亚特王朝统治的政治主张
entries.en: The historian traced the decline of Jacobitism after the rebellions.
entries.zh: 历史学家梳理了叛乱之后詹姆斯党主义的衰落。

entries.meaningZh: Leese：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Leese carried the boxes one at a time.
entries.zh: 利斯一次搬一个箱子。

entries.meaningZh: HCI：human-computer interaction，人机交互
entries.en: The HCI study measured how easily users found the search button.
entries.zh: 这项人机交互研究测量了用户找到搜索按钮的难易程度。

entries.meaningZh: HLCA：horizontal linearity compensation amplifier，行线性补偿放大器的专业缩写
entries.en: The service diagram identifies the HLCA in the display circuit.
entries.zh: 维修图在显示电路中标出了行线性补偿放大器。

entries.meaningZh: Balcon：英语姓氏，本例为虚构人物姓氏
entries.en: Balcon thanked the volunteers before closing the event.
entries.zh: 鲍尔肯在活动结束前感谢了志愿者。
